Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.model

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.model.User
public class User extends Object
Firestore-mapped model for an application user profile.

Field names map 1:1 to Firestore document fields under the users collection (keyed by Firebase Auth UID). Renaming any field in this class will break deserialization of existing documents — migrate the data first.

The no-arg constructor is required by the Firestore SDK for deserialization. Application code should use User(String, String, String) instead.

Since:
1.0

    • User

      public User()

    • User

      public User(String uid, String email, String displayName)
      Creates a new user with the ROLE_STUDENT role and an active account.
      Parameters:
      uid - Firebase Auth UID — primary key for the users document.
      email - Email address used to sign in (must be a @lums.edu.pk address).
      displayName - Human-readable display name.
